---
title: "RDM 2.0 Data Refresh"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: true
  warning: false
---

Pulls a fresh copy of all RDM 2.0 data from REDCap and writes the
pre-computed milestone medians to the `app_cache` REDCap record so that
all IMSLU apps can load them in \~1 second at startup instead of
recomputing from scratch (\~25 seconds).

Schedule this content to run every 30–60 minutes on Posit Connect Cloud.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(gmed)
library(dplyr)
library(REDCapR)

# Required for institutional REDCap SSL certificate
httr::set_config(httr::config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE, ssl_verifyhost = FALSE))

# Validate required environment variables
required_vars <- c("REDCAP_URL", "RDM_TOKEN", "CACHE_RECORD_ID")
missing_vars  <- required_vars[!nzchar(Sys.getenv(required_vars))]
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required environment variables: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

REDCAP_URL      <- Sys.getenv("REDCAP_URL")
RDM_TOKEN       <- Sys.getenv("RDM_TOKEN")
CACHE_RECORD_ID <- Sys.getenv("CACHE_RECORD_ID")
```

```{r}
#| label: pull-redcap
start_time <- Sys.time()
cat("Starting REDCap pull at", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")

rdm_raw <- gmed::load_rdm_complete(
  redcap_url   = REDCAP_URL,
  rdm_token    = RDM_TOKEN,
  raw_or_label = "raw",
  verbose      = FALSE
)

elapsed <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")), 1)
cat("REDCap pull complete in", elapsed, "seconds\n")
cat("Residents loaded:  ", nrow(rdm_raw$residents), "\n")
cat("Forms included:    ", length(rdm_raw$all_forms), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: write-cache
# historical_medians is already computed inside load_rdm_complete;
# write_medians_cache strips processed_data and stores only the summary
# data frames needed by apps for spider plots and comparisons.

if (is.null(rdm_raw$historical_medians) || length(rdm_raw$historical_medians) == 0) {
  cat("WARNING: historical_medians is empty — cache not updated\n")
} else {
  ok <- gmed::write_medians_cache(
    medians         = rdm_raw$historical_medians,
    rdm_token       = RDM_TOKEN,
    redcap_url      = REDCAP_URL,
    cache_record_id = CACHE_RECORD_ID
  )
  if (isTRUE(ok)) {
    cat("Medians cache updated successfully\n")
    cat("Forms cached: ", paste(names(rdm_raw$historical_medians), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("WARNING: medians cache write failed — check logs above\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: summary
cat("---\n")
cat("Completed at:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
```
